meals.name: Berry Banana Oatmeal with Almond Butter
meals.description: A warm and comforting bowl of oats cooked in almond milk, topped with sliced banana, fresh blueberries, and a drizzle of creamy almond butter.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine rolled oats and almond milk over medium heat.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and creamy.
Transfer cooked oatmeal to a bowl.
Top with sliced banana, fresh blueberries, almond butter, and maple syrup before serving.

meals.name: Roasted Sweet Potato and Chickpea Bowl
meals.description: Hearty brown rice served with garlic-roasted sweet potato cubes, crisp chickpeas, steamed broccoli, and a smooth tahini dressing.
ingredients: 0.5 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained
instructions: Toss sweet potato cubes and chickpeas with olive oil, garlic powder, and salt.
Spread evenly on a baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes until tender and crisp.
Steam broccoli florets until bright green and tender-crisp.
Assemble the bowl with a base of brown rice, topped with roasted sweet potato, chickpeas, and broccoli.
Drizzle tahini diluted with 1 tsp warm water over the bowl.

meals.name: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait with Granola
meals.description: Creamy low-fat Greek yogurt layered with crisp granola, sweet fresh strawberries, and honey.
instructions: In a glass or bowl, add half of the Greek yogurt as the base layer.
Add a layer of sliced strawberries followed by half of the granola.
Add the remaining Greek yogurt, topped with the rest of the strawberries and granola.
Drizzle honey over the top layer before serving.
